product.title: Airbag
product.body:
Stay secure on the graphic roads, get yourself Airbag :) 

Designed with a fun and energetic character around a humanist basis, Airbag combines the clarity of a modern sans-serif with details that give it plenty of personality. Its variable weight axis lets you move smoothly from light to bold, while the italic adds a sense of speed and movement whenever the design needs an extra push.

Airbag comes equipped with numerous alternates and style sets, giving you the freedom to fine-tune its appearance and create distinctive combinations. Switch things up, experiment with different letterforms, and find the version that fits your visual language, whether you’re working on a sharp editorial layout, a bold identity, a poster, packaging, or something else for the fast lane.

With its broad range of weights, flexible italics, and playful typographic details, Airbag is made to keep your designs moving. Buckle up, Airbag is ready for the race!
product.seo_title: Airbag ● Fun Energetic Sans-Serif ● Download Free Trials
product.seo_description: Airbag is a playful sans-serif font family with a humanist personality. Full of lively character, the variable typeface is designed for bold identities, editorial design, posters, packaging, branding, logotypes, and expressive typography.

brand.title: En Travaux
brand.body:
En Travaux (ENTX) is a French foundry by Audrey Aujoulat, Dorian Delavault, Julien Simon & friends. We offer free (or accessible) fonts and experimental type works from and to a wide range of design creatives.
